name: Provider Limits
description:
Monitor usage limits of Codex, Claude, OpenCode Go, and Grok/SuperGrok directly in the GNOME top bar: no dashboards or extra commands during refreshes.

* Multi-provider: four providers in a single indicator; Grok is opt-in and uses an existing `grok login` session
* Two display zones: compact status bar for at-a-glance fields; expanded panel on click for full detail
* Per-provider field configuration: choose which fields appear in each zone and in what order
* Adaptive polling: refreshes every 10 seconds while readings change, slows to 120 seconds once stable
* Provider-specific readers: authenticated provider endpoints, disk or CLI fallbacks where available, and partial data when fields are unavailable

The extension reads existing local credentials and usage state. Tokens are read fresh on every refresh and discarded immediately; credentials are never stored or sent to third parties. Network calls go only to provider endpoints. Grok reports subscription credits, not per-model chat message limits or xAI API billing.

Requires GNOME Shell 45+ and Python 3 (stdlib only) for SQLite reading.
